newsitem.title: USA: Northwest Air in tentative Airbus order - WSJ.
newsitem.headline: Northwest Air in tentative Airbus order - WSJ.

text.p: Northwest Airlines has tentatively ordered up to 40 of Airbus Industrie's A-330 airplanes, for as much as $4.2 billion, the Wall Street Journal said in its electronic edition Tuesday.

At least half the planes covered under the preliminary pact were firm orders, the paper said, citing people familiar with the situation. The other orders were set up as future purchase options, the paper said.
A transaction would give Airbus the single largest deal yet for widebody aircraft in North America, the paper said.
An Airbus spokesman was quoted in the paper as saying the European consortium was talking to Northwest about additional airplanes but would not comment further.
